sources: Reserve Florida (floridardr.usedirect.com/FloridaRDR/rdr search/place 59, search/grid and search/details for every unit of facility 163, start date 2026-11-10), read 2026-10-21

values.note: $25 a night for an RV: the $18 campsite fee plus Florida's $7 nightly utility fee for RVs (tent campers pay $18), plus tax and a $6.70 reservation fee per reservation. The park's own Hours & Fees page gives no camping fee.

fees.source: Reserve Florida search/details for facility 163 (all 36 units Rate 18.00, Fee 6.70; start 2026-11-10) + https://www.floridastateparks.org/fees ($7 nightly RV utility fee, as recorded 2026-10-12), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park page says '30 amp available'. Reserve Florida's unit details list Water and Sewer Hookup on every RV-or-tent unit, and 50 amp on some, but they sell 36 units against the park's 23, so the catalog may not match the ground.

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/ruth-b-kirby-gilchrist-blue-springs-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('16 sites for RV/tent camping (30 amp available)') + Reserve Florida search/details for facility 163 (Water Hookup on all units; Sewer Hookup on all 26 'RV or Tent' units, contradicting the earlier note's 'no sewer'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park page says 23 campsites: 16 RV/tent and 7 tent-only. Reserve Florida lists 36 units (26 'RV or Tent', 10 'Tent Only'); only five carry a length (35-40 ft, #018 a 40-ft pull-through).

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/ruth-b-kirby-gilchrist-blue-springs-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('The park features 23 campsites: 16 sites for RV/tent camping (30 amp available) and seven tent-only camping') + Reserve Florida search/grid for facility 163 (#013-#015, #018 VehicleLength 40, #017 35; #018, #020, #028, #029 Pull Through), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/ruth-b-kirby-gilchrist-blue-springs-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521') + Reserve Florida search/place 59 Restrictions (MinimumStay 1, MaximumStay 14), read 2026-10-21

note: Distinct from Orange City's Blue Spring SP. Since Oct 29, 2025 there are no water activities (spring closed for construction renovations; portable toilets in place until they are complete); camping still sold on Reserve Florida (read 2026-10-21). --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 RV night ($18 + $7 utility, $6.70 fee), 30-amp + water, 23 sites, Reserve Florida booking. Added 40-ft max with a pull-through, 14-night max; cleared the note-derived sewer:false (Reserve Florida lists sewer at every RV unit). No Isaias banner; the Oct 2025 construction banner (no water activities) is still up. Not stated: season, window, fcfs (inherited), dump. Note cleaned of field facts and the stale ReserveAmerica line.
flags: Reserve Florida and the park page disagree: 36 units (26 RV-or-tent with water+sewer, 11 at 50 amp) vs the park's '23 campsites: 16 sites for RV/tent camping (30 amp available)'. Sewer cleared rather than set; a person may want to call the park (386-454-1369).

Construction banner still up: 'Effective October 29th, 2025: Due to construction renovations ... there are no water activities available ... The park has port-o-let facilities in place until renovations are complete.' Not recorded as a closure since camping is still sold.
